name: Otchayaniye
source:
This is a story about Alexander. One day, he ended up in the camp and stayed there for a long time. When he realized that he was trapped, he began looking for a way out through hundreds and thousands of cycles.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1573928254]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于亚历山大的故事。有一天，他来到了营地，并在那里呆了很长一段时间。当他意识到自己被困住时，他开始在成百上千的循环中寻找出路。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1573928254]Steam[/url]]
